svg.title: One step of the loop with a grammar mask: whether its fill hides under the forward
svg.desc: Four timelines of one step of the loop, each a CPU lane above a GPU lane on the same scale in microseconds. The CPU plans a step, fills the grammar's bitmask, and reads the result back, and the GPU runs the forward. When the fill is overlapped and light, it sits under the forward, and the GPU idles 160 microseconds between forwards, as it would with no grammar. When the fill is overlapped and heavy, it outlasts the forward, and the GPU idles 380 microseconds. When the fill comes after the forward, none of it hides, and the GPU idles 400 microseconds. With async scheduling the CPU runs a step ahead and the light fill hides, so the GPU idles 0 microseconds.
svg.text: Overlapped, light grammar: the fill hides under the forward
